expectations.text: Recommends one Space per (app, env) deployment boundary, not suffix-naming or one-Space-per-app
expectations.evidence: Explicitly recommends web-dev, web-staging, web-prod, api-dev, api-staging, api-prod as separate Spaces. Warns against suffix-naming with three specific reasons.

expectations.text: Includes a home Space per app for cross-env artifacts (ChangeSets, Tags, Filters, Views)
expectations.evidence: Recommends web-home and api-home. Explains why: operational artifacts are cross-environment and shouldn't be coupled to a single env's lifecycle.

expectations.text: References the existing platform Space for org-wide Triggers/Filters
expectations.evidence: Notes platform already exists, explains it holds org-wide Triggers + Filters, recommends attaching via --trigger-filter platform/standard-vets.

expectations.text: Uses PascalCase, non-abbreviated label keys (Application, Environment, Region/Cluster)
expectations.evidence: Commands use --label Application=web --label Environment=dev --label Cluster=shared-cluster. All PascalCase, no abbreviations.

expectations.text: Shows how labels enable cross-Space queries
expectations.evidence: Three concrete cub unit list --space '*' --where 'Space.Labels.X = Y' examples covering prod, shared-cluster, and cluster-migration impact.

expectations.text: Addresses the upcoming cluster migration without requiring slug changes
expectations.evidence: Explains that when prod moves, update the Cluster label (cub space update web-prod --label Cluster=prod-cluster) — no slug change needed.

expectations.text: Recommends Worker Pattern A (dedicated Worker Space) for shared cluster
expectations.evidence: Recommends Pattern A with workers-shared-cluster Space. Notes when prod moves, install a second Worker in workers-prod-cluster.

expectations.text: Shows promotion flow using Space-to-Space clone/upgrade
expectations.evidence: Includes cub unit create --dest-space web-staging --space web-dev and cub unit update --upgrade.

expectations.text: Uses valid auth check (cub context get or cub space list), not cub info
expectations.evidence: Uses cub context get and explicitly notes NOT cub info.

expectations.text: Respects tool boundary — does not create Units, Triggers, Workers, or Targets
expectations.evidence: Final section explicitly states this skill decides where things go; creating Units/Targets/Triggers belongs to other skills.
